title: MS Paint Style DALL-E Prompt for Photo Stylization
summary: A viral prompting technique for ChatGPT and DALL-E that transforms high-quality uploaded photos into crude, low-fidelity drawings mimicking the classic MS Paint aesthetic.
research_notes: The trend was popularized by Korean users on Threads in early 2026; it is often called 'The Most Trivial Prompt in the World' for using massive compute to generate 8-bit-style art.

evolution.summary: DALL-E 3 has been superseded by GPT-4o, which treats images as native tokens for superior image-to-image consistency. Microsoft has also integrated this technology directly into Windows 11 Paint via the 'Cocreator' feature.
